## Description

In the launch region confirm: batch transcription with diarisation and language identification for en-IN, hi-IN, ta-IN (and ar-AE for UAE), Azure OpenAI chat model with JSON-schema output, data residency/processing terms. Run 10 synthetic recordings through the pipeline and measure WER, diarisation error and latency. Record ADR-007 (speech/LLM providers, models, versions, regions, fallback).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** ADR-007 accepted with model names/versions, regions, quotas and fallback provider abstraction.
- [ ] **AC2.** Measured latency supports the ≤ 60 s p50 draft target or the gap is quantified with a plan.
- [ ] **AC3.** Language/diarisation quality per language is recorded on the synthetic set.
- [ ] **AC4.** Confirmation that no data leaves the country for inference (documented with Microsoft terms).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
